execution: Require --workers-complete, driver-exit.complete=true and the 18 published hash-bound original endpoint records. Reconstruct unchanged original patches on pristine input and restore protected checks identically to the original grader, without changing model production source. Run LightWorkspace.runTask(kind=analyze) through the identical frozen F50 runtime on all arms. witnessReplay: For each returned witness only, extract the exact typed function declaration or exact const function initializer from the captured source and execute it as an isolated TypeScript module using pinned tsx in a child Node process. Preserve its body; no import/module initialization, inlining, source repair or raw SMT/JavaScript eval. Fixed JavaScript expectations implement the same four properties. Record source/declaration/witness/child hashes, result, exit and bounded output sizes/hashes. Label isolated_actual_js, not original-module integration. A failed replay remains visible.
archiving: Keep 24 bounded observations/reasons/result sizes/hashes, witness details when present, actual-JS replay receipts, before/after source and @checks hashes, runtime/solver/dependency bindings and complete counts. Do not archive raw SMT or treat diagnostic time as comparative model performance. Durable partial JSONL remains visible if an infrastructure assertion stops the diagnostic.
limitations: Post-hoc known diagnostic selected after seven results, not new-task or new-project confirmation.

No token, model cost or comparative performance claim follows from this local diagnostic.
sourceHashMethod: Every captured tracked/untracked regular source/config file has a SHA-256 before and after. Tracked deleted paths remain explicit absent entries.
